REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - JULY 5, 2018 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are
available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division, Cerritos City Hall,
18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1254. Materials related to an
item on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Parks and Recreation Commission after
distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Recreation
Services Division at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.
